body_markdown:
**Data from infant immunogenicity and safety trial, and controlled human infection model (CHIM) trial, demonstrate favorable safety profile with encouraging immunogenicity and efficacy signals.**


**Lyon (France), November 9, 2026** –


[Valneva SE](https://valneva.com/?lang=fr)


(Nasdaq: VALN; Euronext Paris: VLA), a specialty vaccine company, today announced positive results from two Phase 2 trials of *Shigella* 4V2 (S4V2), the world’s most clinically advanced tetravalent bioconjugate vaccine candidate against shigellosis. Valneva is evaluating the complete dataset of the Phase 2 infant and CHIM trials to determine the most appropriate path forward for the potential first-in-class vaccine candidate.


To access the full release, please click on the PDF below.
